description: Returns turva.dev's service catalog: the Shopify agent storefront check, agent-readiness audit, advisory, implementation, agent operations, and MCP server design, plus the engagement model and pricing (fixed list prices for the Shopify agent storefront check, audit, advisory and implementation; agent operations and MCP server design on request), and two implementation add-ons that carry a fixed price and are sold only with the diagnosis they follow, bought with it, with its report, or after the report and before implementation starts. Use this when a user asks what turva.dev offers, what it costs, or how an engagement works. For how to reach turva.dev use get_contact instead, and for the rules an engagement follows use get_principles. Read-only: returns static JSON that is compiled into the Worker, so it changes nothing and updates only on deploy.
name: get_services

bundled_implementation.description: Implementation add-ons that are sold only with another service.

price.description: Price in EUR, VAT not included.

requires.description: The id of the service this add-on is sold with.

sold_separately.description: Whether the add-on can be bought without its service. False means it cannot.

summary.description: What the add-on covers and when it is bought.

unit.description: What the price covers, such as fixed.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of every price, EUR.

communication.description: How an engagement is communicated, async_only for written exchange with no calls.

notes.description: Terms of an engagement, one per entry, covering access, scope, dates and completion.

items.description: One term of an engagement as a sentence.

pricing_model.description: The pricing model. fixed_list_prices means fixed list prices, apart from the services priced on request.

pricing_note.description: The VAT treatment by customer type, the services quoted per engagement and the rule for the add-ons.

deliverable.description: What the customer receives and when.

duration.description: How long delivery takes, where the service states one.

duration_from.description: The event the duration counts from, where the service states one.

minimum_commitment.description: The shortest term the service is sold for, where one applies.

price.description: EUR, VAT not included, or on request.

sample_url.description: A published sample of the deliverable, where one exists.

summary.description: What the service covers and its scope.

unit.description: What the price covers, such as fixed, month or day. Absent when the price is on request.

url.description: The turva.dev page that describes the service.

vat_included.description: Whether the prices include VAT. False means every price excludes VAT.

title: Service catalog and pricing
